claims.claim_text: The indexed Technician 4th Grade Marjorie E. Blackburn is confirmed against the exact-name, exact-private-identifier Army record.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Exact name and private identifier match.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official Army merged file contains an exact name and private-identifier match for Marjorie E. Blackburn.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The uncommon full name, middle initial, and exact private identifier confirm identity.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record documents entry on December 29, 1942 and a civilian occupation group, but not the date of OSS assignment.
claims.match_notes: The identifier is withheld publicly. The identity resolution does not establish an employer.

claims.claim_text: At Army entry on December 29, 1942, Marjorie E. Blackburn's recorded civilian occupation group was stenographers and typists.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: NARA's fixed-width Army record carries occupation code 137, which its corrected code list defines as stenographers and typists.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact private identifier and full name link the Army record to the indexed person.
claims.temporal_assessment: The dated Army-entry record is strongly bounded evidence before her indexed Technician 4th Grade service, but it names no employer and gives no OSS start date.
claims.match_notes: The grouped code does not show which occupation applied and is excluded from verified-employer analytics.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Jasper B. Blackenship is confirmed as Jasper B. Blankenship in the official Army record.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Private identifier matches after fixed-width zero padding; Army spelling is Blankenship.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official Army merged file supplies the same private identifier after its fixed-width leading zero is restored and spells the surname Blankenship.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The private identifier, given name, and middle initial confirm identity; the one-letter surname difference is published as a documented variant rather than silently correcting the index.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record is dated October 22, 1945, after OSS dissolution, so its occupation field cannot support a pre-OSS claim.
claims.match_notes: The record is used only for identity. It does not establish a pre-OSS occupation, employer, or chronology.
